ryans.name: Ryan Lightbourn
ryans.title: Filmmaker whose work runs from independent horror features to AI-generated shorts, including the 2026 Lumara Serenissima Award winner Black Thunder
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan Lightbourn** is a filmmaker whose work includes independent horror features and, later, AI-generated shorts [1][2][8]. In 2026 his 12-minute short *Black Thunder* won the Serenissima Award, for best film made with Venice, at the inaugural Lumara Film Festival, presented by MoonPay and Venice; the film was also a Grand Prize finalist [9][10][11].
known_for: The AI short Black Thunder (Lumara Serenissima Award, 2026)
Satoshi Sunrise, a MoonPay-presented AI short (2026)
The independent horror feature All the Devils Are Here, formerly titled Sleepwalkers
